ex.en: The school is five kilometers from my home.
ex.zh: 學校離我家五公里。

ex.en: It is three kilometers from here to the bank.
ex.zh: 從這裡到銀行有三公里。

ex.en: This car can go thirteen kilometers for every liter of gasoline.
ex.zh: 這輛車每公升汽油可以跑十三公里。

kilometer.en: a unit of distance equal to 1,000 meters

ex.en: Don't forget to take the first-aid kit.
ex.zh: 別忘了帶急救箱。

ex.en: I keep a tool kit in the car.
ex.zh: 我在車上放了一套工具組。

ex.en: The welcome kit includes a map and a badge.
ex.zh: 迎賓包裡有一張地圖和一個名牌。

kit.en: a set of things needed for a particular purpose

ex.en: I have gained two kilograms this summer.
ex.zh: 這個夏天我胖了兩公斤。

ex.en: How many kilograms did you lose last month?
ex.zh: 你上個月瘦了幾公斤？

ex.en: Rice is sold by the kilogram.
ex.zh: 米是按公斤賣的。

kilogram.en: a unit of weight equal to 1,000 grams

ex.en: That child may have been kidnapped on his way home.
ex.zh: 那個孩子可能在回家路上被綁架了。

ex.en: He is accused of kidnapping.
ex.zh: 他被控綁架。

kidnap.en: to take someone away by force and hold them, often to ask for money

killer.zh: 殺手；致命的東西（疾病等）

ex.en: Heart disease is the number one killer in many countries.
ex.zh: 在許多國家，心臟病是頭號殺手。

ex.en: Stress can be a silent killer.
ex.zh: 壓力可能是隱形殺手。

killer.en: a person who murders, or something such as an illness that causes death

ex.en: The camera is the killer feature of this phone.
ex.zh: 相機是這支手機的殺手級功能。

ex.en: That was a killer presentation!
ex.zh: 那場簡報太精彩了！

ex.en: How many kinds of birds are in your backyard?
ex.zh: 你家後院有幾種鳥？

ex.en: I don't want to buy this kind of sofa.
ex.zh: 我不想買這種沙發。

ex.en: There are all kinds of people in the world.
ex.zh: 世界上什麼樣的人都有。

kind.en: a group of things or people that are similar

ex.en: He was kind enough to lend me some money.
ex.zh: 他很好心，借了我一些錢。

ex.en: Tom is one of the kindest people I know.
ex.zh: 湯姆是我認識最善良的人之一。

kind.en: friendly, generous and caring toward others

ex.en: I'm kind of tired today.
ex.zh: 我今天有點累。

ex.en: The movie was kind of boring.
ex.zh: 那部電影有點無聊。

kind.en: to some degree, but not completely

ex.en: I had chicken pox when I was a kid.
ex.zh: 我小時候得過水痘。

ex.en: I brought up two kids all on my own.
ex.zh: 我一個人把兩個小孩養大。

ex.en: Because our kids got married, we are now in-laws.
ex.zh: 我們的孩子結婚了，所以我們現在是親家。

ex.en: Tom realized that Mary wasn't kidding.
ex.zh: 湯姆發現瑪莉不是在開玩笑。

ex.en: Are you kidding me?
ex.zh: 你在開玩笑吧？

ex.en: Don't worry, I'm just kidding!
ex.zh: 別擔心，我只是開玩笑的啦！

kid.en: to say something untrue as a joke

ex.en: The volcano erupted suddenly, killing many people.
ex.zh: 火山突然噴發，造成許多人死亡。

ex.en: Most people killed by smoking were not heavy smokers.
ex.zh: 大多數因吸菸而死的人並不是老菸槍。

ex.en: Don't kill too many birds and animals on earth.
ex.zh: 不要過度捕殺地球上的鳥類和動物。

kill.en: to cause a person or animal to die

ex.en: I read a magazine to kill time.
ex.zh: 我看雜誌打發時間。

ex.en: We killed time at a café before the movie.
ex.zh: 電影開演前我們在咖啡店打發時間。

kill.en: to do something to pass time while waiting

kill.zh: kill two birds with one stone：一舉兩得

ex.en: That way I kill two birds with one stone.
ex.zh: 這樣我就一舉兩得了。

ex.en: Let's kill two birds with one stone and visit the client on the way.
ex.zh: 我們順路拜訪客戶，一舉兩得。

kill.en: to solve two problems with a single action

ex.en: If you buy me an ice cream, I'll kiss you.
ex.zh: 如果你買冰淇淋給我，我就親你一下。

ex.en: At the end of the ceremony, the new couple kissed.
ex.zh: 典禮結束時，新人互相親吻。

kiss.en: to touch someone with your lips to show love or greeting

ex.en: The grand prize is a kiss from the princess.
ex.zh: 頭獎是公主的一個吻。

ex.en: She gave her son a goodnight kiss.
ex.zh: 她給兒子一個晚安吻。

kiss.en: a touch with the lips to show love or greeting

ex.en: He is kicking me!
ex.zh: 他在踢我！

ex.en: He kicked the ball into the goal.
ex.zh: 他把球踢進球門。

kick.en: to hit something with your foot

ex.en: The coin toss decides who will kick off the match.
ex.zh: 擲硬幣決定由哪一隊開球。

ex.en: The conference kicks off on Monday.
ex.zh: 研討會星期一開幕。

kick.en: to begin, especially a game or an event

ex.en: They kicked him out of the disco without any explanation.
ex.zh: 他們沒有任何解釋就把他趕出了舞廳。

ex.en: He was kicked out of the team.
ex.zh: 他被踢出了球隊。

kick.en: to force someone to leave a place or group

ex.en: Once there lived a king whose name was Alfred.
ex.zh: 從前有一位名叫阿佛烈的國王。

ex.en: The king will appear in person tomorrow evening.
ex.zh: 國王明晚會親自現身。

ex.en: When I grow up, I want to be king.
ex.zh: 我長大後想當國王。

king.en: a man who rules a country because of his royal family

ex.en: He needs a kidney transplant.
ex.zh: 他需要腎臟移植。

ex.en: Drinking enough water is good for your kidneys.
ex.zh: 喝足夠的水對腎臟有益。

kidney.en: one of two body parts that clean the blood and make urine

ex.en: I can hear Tom in the kitchen washing dishes.
ex.zh: 我聽到湯姆在廚房洗碗的聲音。

ex.en: Tell the children to stay out of the kitchen.
ex.zh: 告訴孩子別進廚房。

ex.en: American kitchens are much bigger than Japanese ones.
ex.zh: 美式廚房比日式廚房大得多。

kitchen.en: a room where food is prepared and cooked

ex.en: The teachers are playing games with students in the kindergarten.
ex.zh: 幼兒園裡，老師正在帶領小朋友們嘻戲。

ex.en: She is a child-care worker in a kindergarten.
ex.zh: 她是幼兒園裡的保育員。

ex.en: Layla is Sami's new kindergarten teacher.
ex.zh: 蕾拉是薩米新的幼稚園老師。

kindergarten.en: a school for very young children before primary school

ex.en: All her kin came from different cities for the wedding.
ex.zh: 她所有的親戚都從各地趕來參加婚禮。

ex.en: The hospital needs to contact the patient's next of kin.
ex.zh: 醫院需要聯絡病人的最近親屬。

ex.en: Kindly confirm the delivery address by noon.
ex.zh: 請於中午前確認送貨地址。

ex.en: The receptionist kindly helped our visitors.
ex.zh: 接待人員親切地協助訪客。

kindly.en: used to ask politely, or in a friendly and caring way

ex.en: Buy your transit pass at the kiosk beside the station entrance.
ex.zh: 請在車站入口旁的小亭購買交通月票。

ex.en: Passengers checked in at a self-service kiosk.
ex.zh: 乘客在自助服務機辦理報到。

kiosk.en: a small booth selling things, or a machine people use to get a service

ex.en: The prince lived in a small kingdom by the sea.
ex.zh: 王子住在海邊的一個小王國。

ex.en: The United Kingdom is made up of four countries.
ex.zh: 聯合王國由四個國家組成。

ex.en: Mushrooms do not belong to the plant kingdom.
ex.zh: 蕈菇不屬於植物界。

ex.en: Whales are part of the animal kingdom.
ex.zh: 鯨魚屬於動物界。

ex.en: The school is two kilometres from my house.
ex.zh: 學校距離我家兩公里。

ex.en: She runs five kilometres every morning.
ex.zh: 她每天早上跑五公里。

killing.zh: 殺、使死亡（kill 的現在分詞）

ex.en: The cold weather is killing the plants in the garden.
ex.zh: 寒冷的天氣正在讓花園裡的植物枯死。

ex.en: Too much stress is killing his health.
ex.zh: 過多的壓力正在摧毀他的健康。

ex.en: The police are investigating the killing of a shop owner.
ex.zh: 警方正在調查一起店老闆遭殺害的案件。

ex.en: The newspaper reported on the killing for several days.
ex.zh: 報紙連續幾天報導了這起殺人案。

ex.en: My feet are killing me after the long walk.
ex.zh: 走了這麼久的路，我的腳痛得要命。

ex.en: The hike up the mountain was a killing climb.
ex.zh: 那趟上山的健行爬得累死人。

kim.zh: 金姆（常見的人名或姓氏）

ex.en: Kim is studying to become a nurse.
ex.zh: 金姆正在讀書準備成為護理師。

ex.en: I saved a seat for Kim at the front of the room.
ex.zh: 我幫金姆在教室前面留了一個位子。

ex.en: The children flew a kite in the park on a windy day.
ex.zh: 孩子們在有風的日子裡到公園放風箏。

ex.en: My kite got stuck in a tall tree.
ex.zh: 我的風箏卡在一棵高樹上。

kite.zh: 像風箏一樣飛、輕快移動

ex.en: The little boat kited across the waves in the strong wind.
ex.zh: 那艘小船在強風中像風箏般輕快地掠過浪面。

ex.en: Sea birds kite above the cliffs on the wind.
ex.zh: 海鳥乘著風在懸崖上方像風箏般盤旋。

ex.en: Thank you for your kindness when I was sick.
ex.zh: 謝謝你在我生病時的善意關照。

ex.en: A small act of kindness can brighten someone's day.
ex.zh: 一個小小的善舉就能讓某人的一天變得明亮。

ex.en: The kidnapping shocked the whole town.
ex.zh: 這起綁架案震驚了整個小鎮。

ex.en: Police are investigating a kidnapping case.
ex.zh: 警方正在調查一起綁架案。

ex.en: Kinship is very important in many small villages.
ex.zh: 在許多小村莊裡，親屬關係非常重要。

ex.en: The family tree shows the kinship between cousins and uncles.
ex.zh: 這張家族樹顯示了堂表兄弟姊妹與叔伯之間的親屬關係。

kinda.zh: 有點、算是（kind of 的口語）

ex.en: I'm kinda tired, so let's stay home tonight.
ex.zh: 我有點累，所以今晚我們待在家吧。

ex.en: The movie was kinda boring, but the ending was great.
ex.zh: 這部電影有點無聊，不過結尾很棒。

ex.en: She kinda likes him, but she won't admit it.
ex.zh: 她算是喜歡他，只是不肯承認。

ex.en: The kitten curled up on my lap and fell asleep.
ex.zh: 小貓蜷縮在我的腿上睡著了。

ex.en: We adopted a tiny kitten from the shelter.
ex.zh: 我們從收容所領養了一隻小小貓。
